When it comes to selling digital products, Stripe and PayPal are household names, but they have severe limitations. Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 on earth, leaving a vast majority of creators in the dark. PayPal's account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. These options may seem convenient, but they come with a steep price: geographical constraints, uncertain payment timelines, and loss of ownership. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a robust, permanent solution that empowers creators to control their commerce stacks, free from platform restrictions and fees.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The reason you can't use Stripe or PayPal in your country is because they don't operate there. This isn't a problem of technology; it's a matter of business strategy. By excluding certain countries, these platforms avoid regulatory complexities and minimize risk. However, this exclusion comes at your expense. You're left without a reliable payment solution, forcing you to adapt or abandon your business. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to thrive in restricted countries. By building on open-source tools and decentralized networks, it provides a permanent structural alternative that bypasses platform restrictions and allows creators to collect payments without geographical limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees are crucial factors when choosing a payment solution. Stripe and PayPal may seem fast, but they come with high fees, especially for international transactions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers lightning-fast payment processing with fees as low as 0.5%. This means you keep more of your hard-earned revenue and can scale your business without breaking the bank. You're not a victim of platform restrictions; you're a pioneer of sovereign commerce.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When you use Stripe or PayPal, you're essentially renting a payment solution. You have limited control over your commerce stack, and ownership is not guaranteed. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers creators to own their commerce stacks, free from platform restrictions and fees. With automation and delivery built-in, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products, knowing that your payment solution is secure, reliable, and responsive to your needs.
